description: With Bearer auth and confirmed=true, spend workspace credits and release the immutable saved quote. MCP accepts credits only for this tool; fund the workspace first. Reuse the same quote id after a timeout; retries never send it twice. authorizing / needs_review requires reconciliation, not a replacement order. Staging never mails. Email to Postcard quotes require a production workspace credential and the usual OAuth read/write/send permissions.
name: send_product_quote
title: Send Product Quote
